ruleset_id.description: Lowercase ASCII package id; must equal the package directory name under plugins/coc-keeper/rulesets/.

schema_versions.description: Campaign/actor state schema versions this package supports (exact-match only, no migrations).

rule_graph.description: Optional path to the package's generated rule-graph.json (contract docs/ruleset-contract.md §2). Absence means every family defaults to legacy ownership.

rule_graph_manifest.description: Optional path to the package's rule-graph-manifest.json. Absence means every family defaults to legacy ownership.

rule_graph_adapter.description: Optional package-owned adapter for composed RuleGraph settlements. Generic one-plan/one-executor decisions require no adapter.

resources.description: Resource registry (contract §6): declared package-owned state such as HP/SAN/MP/Luck.

projected.description: When true, the kernel projects current_<key> into the runtime player-safe investigator surface. Optional; defaults to false when absent.

rule_families.description: Per-family rule-graph runtime ownership (contract §2.2). Optional; absent means every family defaults to legacy runtime ownership with a visible legacy Keeper surface.

family_id.description: One of the rule-graph contract rule_families ids (e.g. healing, combat).

runtime_owner.description: legacy: the existing Keeper-visible path owns execution; shadow: the legacy path executes and the RuleGraph only compares plans (spec §14.1); graph: the RulesRuntime settlement path is the sole Keeper-visible owner (spec §14.3).

legacy_surface.description: Lifecycle of the legacy Keeper-visible operations for this family (spec §7.7). hidden keeps the adapter host-internal; removed deletes it. One family cannot have runtime_owner graph while its legacy Keeper surface remains visible.

state_dirs.description: Package-owned campaign state directories (contract §6), placed directly under the campaign save/ directory. Optional; defaults to no package dirs when absent.

create_on_init.description: When true, the kernel creates save/<name> at campaign creation; otherwise the owning subsystem creates it lazily. Optional; defaults to false when absent.

role.description: Semantic kernel role for this package directory. Exactly one actor_state directory is required for the package-neutral actor.create and state-authoritative rules.resource_delta path.

boundary_terms.description: ASCII machine-facing terms (characteristics, resource labels) that table-language localization rewrites only on ASCII token boundaries (contract §6). Optional; defaults to an empty set when absent.
